title: The category of probabilistic metric spaces
summary: The paper is devoted to a categorical study of the category of probabilistic metric spaces. The study is based on an isomorphic description of the category of probabilistic metric spaces. The isomorphic description was obtained in [3] and is in terms of objects that are sets endowed with a collection of distances, where the distances involved do not satisfy the triangle inequality but fulfil a mixed triangle condition instead.
